articleguidance-desc: Enables users to create articles through a guided, assisted workflow
articleguidance-specialnewarticle-exists: An article titled "$1" already exists on this wiki.
articleguidance-sources-subtitle: Sources help readers check the facts and shows why this topic matters.
articleguidance-sources-notability-descr: This type of article may face notability concerns. Please provide reliable sources that demonstrate the subject meets Wikipedia's notability guidelines.
articleguidance-sources-url-placeholder: Paste a link to a source
articleguidance-sources-duplicate: This source has already been added
articleguidance-sources-helper: You can add sources while you write.
articleguidance-sources-helper-required: $1 articles on this wiki require sources.
articleguidance-sources-unreliable-warni: This source type is rarely accepted for this article type.
articleguidance-sources-check-failed: Source check failed. Please try again.
articleguidance-instructions-guidance-in: Here are a few tips to help you write a great article.
articleguidance-instructions-source-guid: Make sure you have reliable, independent sources about this topic before you start.
articleguidance-notability-warning: New articles of this type are often deleted on this wiki. Starting with one of the options below gives new contributors a better chance to succeed
articleguidance-notability-options-headi: Here's how you can contribute instead
articleguidance-notability-option-wikida: Create a structured data entry that all Wikipedia can use
articleguidance-notability-option-learn-: Learn what this wiki looks for in new articles
Understand what the community looks for
articleguidance-notability-tag-wikidata: Only topics that exist on Wikidata can be created.
articleguidance-notability-tag-crosswiki: Only topics that are available in {{PLURAL:$1|other language|other languages}} can be created.
articleguidance-notability-tag-junior: Restrictions apply to junior editors only.
articleguidance-notability-tag-draft: Publication allowed only under the draft or user namespace.
articleguidance-notability-tag-sources: Only topics for which the user provided reliable sources not discouraged by the community can be created.
articleguidance-notability-tag-draft-loc: Your article will be created at "$1".
articleguidance-tracking-category-desc: Pages in this category use the <article-guidance> tag to provide structured guidance for article creation.
tag-articleguidance-description: Edit was made using the Article Guidance workflow
